title: Dolly Zoom Out
description: A dolly zoom out retreats on wheels while the lens zooms in, the figure shrinking or holding while space yawns. The background stretches away; the face can stay as the room leaves.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Leave, but keep the face. A hallway that lengthens, a room that becomes a tunnel, a person stranded in stretching space.
The retreat is physical; the glass fights it so the figure does not simply become a speck. A plain pull-out shrinks everyone honestly.
A plain zoom-in tightens from sticks. The compound keeps a face in play while geography yawns.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Dolly out along the lens axis while zooming toward a longer focal length, timed so subject size holds or shrinks slowly. Background compresses and stretches away (more telephoto) as you retreat.
Prompt: Dolly zoom out on [Subject], the figure shrinking or holding while space yawns, a retreat that stretches the room.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to leave a person while keeping their face in the argument, the room stretching. Do not use it as a fancy pull-out for headroom.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a pull-out. The tell: the person shrinks and the room stays honest.
The fix: dolly out plus zoom in, background stretching, face held or slowly shrinking.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Dolly Zoom Out in film?
A dolly zoom out dollies away while zooming in, so the figure holds or shrinks slowly while the background stretches. The room yawns; the face can stay.
Dolly Zoom Out vs Pull Out
A pull-out retreats with honest perspective and the person simply gets smaller. Dolly zoom out fights the retreat with a zoom-in so space warps.
When should I use Dolly Zoom Out?
Use it to leave someone while keeping their face, the geography stretching. Do not use it for ordinary headroom.
How do I prompt Dolly Zoom Out for AI image or video?
Write dolly out plus zoom in. Example: Dolly zoom out on [Subject], the figure shrinking or holding while space yawns, a retreat that stretches the room.
